status: post-hoc synthesis and deterministic replay of previously authored inputs; not a blind or preregistered model comparison
case_selection: All 25 P and all 32 L questions in the frozen 1000-source protocol; no outcome-based selection
candidate_rule: Use each question's complete frozen 1000 distinct full-conversation source IDs. Do not filter by sample_id, family, original/distractor status, person, or official reference.
time_rule: Check applicability of the exact explicit-month-plus-year interval parser used in smm-person-time-1000-pilot-001; do not infer relative dates, and do not add a time score when there is no applicable interval.
metrics: Top5 and Top10 at least one official reference, all official references, and number of individual references; source coverage is not answer correctness.
